scope: All 108 names: the text was compared name by name with the page images of the TTD book (pp. 1–2), and every meaning was read against its name. There are no word-by-word glosses on this page (the meanings are per name). The range-number flags are the block labels. Names 11–15 are the five supplied for the print's repeated names, as SOURCES §12.2 explains.

items.issue: The print spells maṅgaḷa- (names 24, 85) and kaḷyāṇa- (100) with ḷ, as the other pages from this book do; this page had l.
Name 51, sarvopanyāsāya, is confirmed as the print's reading; other lists have sarvopāsyāya (“worshipped by all”).
items.change: The meaning now mentions the other reading, and SOURCES lists it with the other readings kept.

items.issue: Name 36 is printed ghrakāriṇe; the page rightly reads śīghrakāriṇe, but the correction was not recorded.
